RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
The component and its stylesheet are written. Key decisions:

- `Row` and `DataTable` are named exports; no `any`, no unsafe casts.
- Loading state renders 5 `<tr>` rows with `<td>` shimmer spans — same semantic elements as real rows, no `aria-hidden`, so `getByRole` queries work correctly.
- `@keyframes` is inside `@layer components` per the constraint.
- Animates only `opacity` (constraint: only `transform`/`opacity`).
- Component-tier tokens (`--shelf-data-table-*`) used for all visual values — these would need to be defined in `tokens.css` for the full token chain to resolve.
